about: The league's people for the pictures (league chat, 22.10.2026): who they are and their photo in scripts/assets/. A face is always preserved; clothes follow the scene (outfit: their usual look) unless keep says what never changes. style: how a person is always drawn, whatever the scene. team: the league team's index (0-7, src/teams.js) of a GM.

people.name: Зак Онн
people.keep: always the league's Lawyer with a capital L, and always the bright red baseball cap with white embroidered text "God Bless America", spelled exactly
people.outfit: tailored charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, plain black tie

people.name: Адам Сильверов
people.outfit: white shirt with rolled sleeves and a dark red tie

people.name: Фрэнки Мердер
people.keep: curly dark hair and a full beard
people.outfit: dark aviator sunglasses, black leather jacket, red tartan scarf, gold rings and a cigar

people.name: Джек Потт
people.keep: dark rectangular sunglasses (his eyes are never shown), a short beard and moustache, diamond stud earrings
people.outfit: black cap embroidered "Jack Pott", black velvet jacket, gold chain, gold watch and a gold ring

people.name: Роберт Хачатурян
people.keep: round dark-rimmed glasses, a full dark beard, short dark hair
people.outfit: dark suit jacket over an open-collar white shirt, the club's pin on the lapel

people.name: Капитан Торрес Нью-Вин
people.style: always drawn exactly as in his photo: a flat hand-drawn cartoon character, even inside a photographic scene
people.keep: always a pirate: black tricorn pirate hat with gold trim, red bandana, navy pirate coat with gold trim and buttons; short reddish beard

people.name: Лемариус
people.keep: thin rimless tinted glasses, a full brown beard
people.outfit: a grimdark inquisitor-gunslinger: wide-brimmed leather hat with a golden winged badge, battered armour under a long coat, red bandana, a cigar

people.name: Фы Жил
people.keep: long dark braids with bronze beads, a short dark beard, black sunglasses (his eyes are never shown)
people.outfit: a black nomad's robe with orange-patterned leather straps and bronze buckles, a long orange scarf

people.name: Коуч I
people.style: always rendered as a classical oil painting, exactly as in his photo, even inside a photographic scene
people.keep: always an emperor: imperial dark-green velvet uniform with gold embroidery, a blue sash and an ermine mantle; curly dark hair, short beard

people.name: Джонатан Жопа
people.keep: curly brown hair, large metal-frame glasses
people.outfit: a red velour pullover with stripes

people.name: Майк Роффон
people.keep: white gloves and a vintage chrome microphone, always
people.outfit: dressed as a sports reporter, his clothes fit the scene (a blazer or a suit with a press badge, a coat outside); the camouflage helmet and the PRESS vest of his photo are worn only in a war-correspondent scene, never at an arena or a press conference
